text:
Iris (Partnerships): We need a concise CSV snapshot for the cost model: per-SKU, per-region, reserved vs spot, and commit-tenor. Weekly buckets are fine.
Tom (VoltCloud Sales): Will do. Which tenors? 1/6/12/24? And do you need late-bind details?
Iris (Partnerships): Yes 1/6/12/24. Please flag late-bind and include max_regions if true. Also add guaranteed_min_vgpu_hrs/month.
Jordan (Finance): Include these columns too: gross_price_usd_per_hr, post_rebate_price_usd_per_hr, spot_floor_usd_per_hr, early_termination_fee_pct, billing_granularity (sec). We'll normalize afterwards.
Aisha (Ops): Ops needs maintenance_blackout (weekly windows), az_coverage_count, and supports_live_migration boolean.
Marco (Eng): From eng: eviction_p50_min, eviction_p90_min, preempt_signal_min, and a tiny sample eviction_log (date,sku,region,duration_min) for last 60d. Also latency_p50_ms for cold start.
Tom (VoltCloud Sales): Example header I'll upload so you can confirm format:
```
sku,sku_label,region,commit_tenor_mos,gross_price_usd_hr,post_rebate_price_usd_hr,spot_floor_usd_hr,early_termination_fee_pct,billing_granularity_sec,currency,late_bind,max_regions,guaranteed_min_vgpu_hrs_per_month,az_coverage_count,supports_live_migration,eviction_p50_min,eviction_p90_min,preempt_signal_min,latency_cold_p50_ms,maintenance_blackout,notes
VC-A100-40,volt-a100-40,us-west1,12,2.25,1.95,0.48,5,3600,USD,false,0,120000,3,true,18,60,10,120,"Sun 02:00-03:00 UTC","term rebate after 30d"
```
Tom (VoltCloud Sales): I'll upload capacity_matrix.csv + eviction_log_sample.csv + README to the partner bucket and paste the link here.
SyncBot: File uploaded: vc_partner_snapshot_2026-03-22.zip (https://storage.voltcloud.com/partners/vc_partner_snapshot_2026-03-22.zip)
Iris (Partnerships): Great — please ensure README maps columns and units and includes whether net prices are volume or term adjusted. We'll ingest and run a sanity check.
Jordan (Finance): After ingest I'll request a 30m review slot if anything looks off. Thanks everyone.
Tom (VoltCloud Sales): Happy to help — ping me @tom for clarifications.
